about: Questions for the maths benchmark's retrieval measure (decision record 30). Each names the passage that answers it by quoting the lecture's prose exactly from docs/evaluation/maths/corpus/, never its maths, so that the quote can be found whether the maths was read or not. also names another passage that answers just as well. Kinds: term names the topic exactly (term must appear in the question and its evidence); meaning describes it in other words (avoid lists words the question must not use); formula asks for a formula or a method written as one; notation types the maths itself as words, as a learner would type it into a search box.
reviewed: 2026-11-24, in a second pass separate from writing them: every question and its evidence rechecked against the lectures by a reviewer given no access to the author's reasoning, its findings then reconciled one by one; four questions reworded, two alternative passages and two steadier quotes added. Not an independent human review.
